notes: «جميعا» and «قالا» mark the convergence of both routes at شعبة; the names after it are written once and sit in shared_tail.
«بمثل حديث ابن جعفر» (a comparison with another route) and «وفي حديث ابن معاذ من الزيادة» (an added wording) are left out.
The last link is «أبيه», the father of Munthir, named only as the father: relation.
